properties.name: The Birchwood
properties.description: Built in 1926 and artfully restored, The Birchwood blends historic Gilded Age charm with ski-in mountain elegance, stone fireplaces, and an acclaimed summer courtyard for weddings.

properties.name: Copperline Inn
properties.description: A cozy timber and slate haven just steps from Breckenridge Gondola. Designed for winter powder hounds and summer singletrack mountain bikers.

properties.name: Sundowner Lodge
properties.tagline: Park City Premier Alpine Resort & Gathering Place
properties.description: Lumen’s largest property features 51 rooms, expansive conference halls, farm-to-table dining at the on-site Hearth Restaurant, and effortless access to Deer Valley and Park City Mountain.

properties.name: The Wren House
properties.tagline: Intimate Quiet-Luxury Hideaway in Box Canyon
properties.description: Nineteen individually curated suites offering bespoke butler service, panoramic box canyon views, deep soaking tubs, and unmatched exclusivity.

properties.name: Cedar & Salt
properties.tagline: Desert Modern Haven Between Red Rocks & Canyons
properties.description: A striking minimalist desert sanctuary framed by Moab’s red rock cliffs. Offering stargazing terraces, plunge pools, and tailored private expeditions into Arches and Canyonlands.

properties.name: The Ledger
properties.tagline: Modern Architectural Boutique in Downtown SLC
properties.description: Sophisticated downtown urban atelier combining mid-century brass aesthetic with high-speed digital amenities, rooftop cocktail lounge, and seamless airport connectivity.

roomTypes.name: Deluxe Heritage King
roomTypes.description: Handcrafted timber furnishings, gas fireplace, and plush velvet seating with serene courtyard garden views.

roomTypes.name: Mountain View King Suite
roomTypes.description: Expansive private balcony facing Ajax Mountain, separate living parlor, deep clawfoot soaking tub, and dual fireplaces.

roomTypes.name: The 1926 Presidential Penthouse
roomTypes.description: The crowning jewel of The Birchwood. Private elevator access, vaulted beam ceilings, chef’s pantry, and private rooftop cedar hot tub.

roomTypes.name: San Juan Sanctuary Suite
roomTypes.description: Ultra-exclusive sanctuary. Hand-carved stone fireplace, cashmere throws, daily in-suite French breakfast, and direct canyon views.

roomTypes.name: Telluride Box Canyon Chalet
roomTypes.description: A private residential chalet with floor-to-ceiling glass framing Bridal Veil Falls, private chef service on demand, and private wine cellar.

roomTypes.name: Alpine Double Queen
roomTypes.description: Ideal for ski groups and mountain bikers. Custom ski racks in room, heated slate bathroom floors, and gear drying closet.

roomTypes.name: Copperline Timber Loft
roomTypes.description: Two-story loft with spiral staircase, wood-burning stove, and forest canopy terrace.

roomTypes.name: Sundowner Mountain King
roomTypes.description: Warm terracotta accents, luxury bedding, work desk with mountain views, and direct elevator to the Hearth restaurant.

roomTypes.name: Deer Valley Executive Suite
roomTypes.description: Designed for corporate retreats and family vacations with conference-ready dining table and dual bathrooms.

roomTypes.name: Red Rock Patio King
roomTypes.description: Floor-to-ceiling glass opening onto a private sandstone terrace with firepit and panoramic views of the red cliff face.

roomTypes.name: The Canyons Stargazer Suite
roomTypes.description: Features a private rooftop deck equipped with Celestron telescope and outdoor soak tub under the dark sky preserve.

roomTypes.name: Urban Atelier Studio
roomTypes.description: Mid-century brass and midnight navy styling, acoustic sound dampening, workstation, and Tivoli audio system.

roomTypes.name: Wasatch Corner Suite
roomTypes.description: Panoramic downtown and Wasatch mountain corner views with soaking tub and private meeting salon.

rooms.quirks: Lock deadbolt needs slight handle lift when turning key.
Near service elevator; keep sound-dampening door seals firmly seated.
Historic radiator requires valve bleed every 3 weeks in winter. Do not overtighten brass knob.
Antique window latch needs gentle upward pull before sliding.
HVAC sensor is on east wall, adjust by 1° higher for true temperature.
